workarounds.symptom: fix(news): one hanging feed holds every full digest build to the deadline, and the 14s timeout then serves stale
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(news): cache a feed that used its whole per-feed timeout. Target files: server/worldmonitor/news/v1/_attempts.ts, tests/digest-attempt-outcomes.test.mts, tests/news-feed-background-refresh.test.mts. One hanging feed, `La Nation` (`https://www.lanation.dj/feed/`, `middleeast`, fetched in every language), held about 1 in 10 `full` digest builds to the 10 s feed deadline. About a quarter of those builds then missed the 14 s cache-layer timeout. Those requests threw away the build and served a stale digest 15 to 24 min... (Ref: https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor/pull/11135)

workarounds.symptom: MCP tool canary: production tool failures
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): unlist the orbital tools while Orbital Watch is dark. Target files: api/_product-catalog.generated.js, api/mcp/alias.ts, api/mcp/constants.ts. Orbital Watch ships dark (#10710). In production, `ORBITAL_WATCH_ENABLED` is unset, so `api/orbital/v1/[rpc].ts` returns `404 {"error":"Not found"}` for every orbital RPC. I confirmed this on 2026-11-14: `GET /api/orbital/v1/get-point-passes` and `get-country-imagery-evidence` both return 404 with `cache-control: no-store`, which is the dark response. (Ref: https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor/pull/10729)
